profile.reasoning: Mikael Nkosi is a seasoned supply chain and logistics professional with a unique background: he spent a significant portion of his career building out operations *within* emerging African markets, specifically focusing on last-mile delivery and infrastructure development. profile.positioning: A results-oriented and globally-minded logistics leader, I bring over 15 years of experience optimizing supply chain performance across diverse and challenging environments. My career has been defined by a commitment to building robust, scalable solutions that empower local communities while delivering exceptional value to stakeholders. I specialize in navigating the complexities of emerging markets, particularly within Africa, where I’ve successfully established and scaled last-mile delivery networks, negotiated critical infrastructure partnerships, and implemented innovative logistics strategies. Currently, as Director of Global Logistics at StellarTech Electronics, I am responsible for overseeing end-to-end supply chain operations, encompassing sourcing, procurement, transportation, warehousing, and distribution across multiple continents. I’ve recently led a successful initiative to reduce transportation costs by 18% through strategic carrier negotiations and route optimization. However, my passion lies in the intersection of traditional logistics and emerging technologies. I am a firm believer in the transformative potential of Web3 – specifically blockchain and tokenization – to enhance supply chain transparency, traceability, and resilience. I am actively seeking a leadership opportunity where I can leverage my expertise to drive innovation and build future-proof supply chain solutions that are both economically viable and socially responsible. I believe a truly resilient supply chain isn’t just about minimizing risk, it’s about building a system that benefits all participants, from the manufacturer to the end consumer, and the communities within which it operates.
